thread:
Ava (Marketing): Ok team — we need to relaunch the fortnightly benchmark newsletter next Wednesday. goal: drive webinar signups + trial activations. thinking shorter copy, one benchmark highlight, CTA to register. timeline: content freeze by Tue EOD.
Mateo (Growth): +1. can we keep send window to Tue/Thu 9-11am PT to hit NA mornings? also want an AB test on subject line.
Priya (Content): Drafting 3 subject lines now — working titles: `New: latency benchmarks you can run in 5m`, `Cut inference costs 2x — our new benches`, `What model configs actually save money` — will push to doc in 2hrs.
Jules (Design): I'll prepare the header image + mobile-safe hero. note: avoid >100kb to prevent clipping.
Sam (Ops): Heads-up — we need suppressed list from sales for closed-won and do-not-contact. also include `unsubscribed` and `bounce` lists. I'll run query and post snippet here.
Mateo (Growth): Segments: 1) New signups last 30d (onboard nurture), 2) Active trial users (high priority), 3) Cold enterprise leads (soft-touch). Target cadence: send to group 1 & 2 for now, hold #3 for next month.
Priya (Content): For the AB subject test: A = `Latency wins: get faster responses for cheaper`, B = `Benchmark case study + how-to`. Which metric do we track? open -> click -> webinar reg.
Ava (Marketing): Track via UTM: `utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=bench_relaunch_mar26&utm_content=subjectA|B`. Mateo, can you wire tracking to the event funnel?
Mateo (Growth): Yup. I'll set up click -> register conversion and pass `variant` param.
Sam (Ops): Suppression query (will run and share full list):
```
SELECT email FROM users WHERE status IN ('unsubscribed','bounced')
UNION
SELECT email FROM sales_contacts WHERE stage='closed_won'
```
Sam (Ops): Also plan a deliverability preflight on Tue: seed list, Gmail/Outlook tests, spam-assassin score. need final HTML by Mon noon.
Jules (Design): Small ask — can we use a dark CTA button? stands out better on mobile. Ava — ok?
Ava (Marketing): Dark CTA is fine. keep accessible contrast. also add text fallback for clients that block buttons.
Priya (Content): Draft copy pushed: short hook, 2 bullet highlights, CTA to webinar + link to full bench report (one pager).
Mateo (Growth): Let's throttle send to 10k/hr for first 2 hours to avoid ramps on ESP. set off-peak send to APAC later in day (6pm PT).
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: content freeze in 36 hours (https://docs.company.com/bench-relaunch).
Ava (Marketing): Owners/next steps: Priya final copy (Mon 11am), Jules final assets (Mon 3pm), Sam suppression + deliverability checks (Tue morning), Mateo tracking + variants wired (Tue noon). I'll own the send and post-send analysis.
Priya (Content): I'll add 2 micro-personalization tokens: `{{company}}` and `{{trial_days_left}}` for trial users.
Mateo (Growth): For reporting, let's measure: open rate by subject variant, click-to-register, webinar show rate, and trial activation within 7 days. make a chart in the dashboard.
Sam (Ops): One more ask: ensure link shortener supports tracking and preserves UTM parameters. some clients strip long UTM strings.
Ava (Marketing): Good catch. use our redirector `go.redwood.ai/bench` with UTM passthrough.
Jules (Design): Uploading final hero + mobile slices to the doc now.
Mateo (Growth): :thumbsup: Planning a quick sync Tue 9:30am if anything blocks — otherwise we ship Wed morning.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks all — quick wins: keep subject only 50 chars for mobile, avoid images-only top, and preview text should tease the webinar. I'll post final checklist in the doc.
